description: This file contains SDK functions for interacting with LiteLLM's A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol, including functions for sending messages (both synchronous and asynchronous streaming), creating clients, and fetching agent cards. It provides decorators for logging, handles special routing via a completion bridge, manages external dependencies, and integrates with the A2A SDK if available.

classes.name: A2AStreamingIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for streaming responses from the A2A client, used to yield response chunks asynchronously.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: Utility class for structured logging of A2A request/response lifecycle, used within streaming and messaging functions.

methods.description: Asynchronous generator to send a streaming message to an A2A agent, with optional completion bridge support and detailed logging.
